notes.title: Version 1.1.4 - Happy New Year!
notes.content:
* Using new data storage system to allow for better save files.
* Importing/Exporting save files is now supported again!

notes.title: Demo Now Available
notes.content:
With 1 week left to go, yes just 1 week until the release of Veritas, we thought it’d be nice to release a short demo just to get everyone ready.

So without further ado, please download the demo now!

notes.title: Launch Date Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33821673/f794e1016b2fd6ff416cc5ae6a599f627bbc4569.png[/img]

In case you missed the news, Veritas will be out on February 12th! That's less than a month away people, get ready!

[previewyoutube=HN8f1hD015Q;full][/previewyoutube]

This next month is going to be very hard for us as we are a very small company ( just two people ) and have a very small marketing budget.

[h2]We would love for your continued support by helping us get the word out![/h2]

Do you watch any [b]streamers[/b] who play point and click games? Please tell them about Veritas so they can check it out! You wouldn't want them to be [i]that[/i] person that didn't know about a game that will no doubt have people talking about for years to come ( maybe? )

Make sure your [b]friends[/b] know of the game too, so you can be [i]that[/i] person that is cool and tells their friends about things before they're mainstream.

Don't forget to tell the [b]stranger[/b] on the tube too so you can be [i]that[/i] person that everybody avoids, but at least you get an empty carriage to play Veritas in.

To make things easier, we have a new website setup just for the game - [url=https://www.veritasthegame.com/]https://www.veritasthegame.com/[/url]

Please consider joining our Discord too, we're friendly - [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/hhUVfq]https://discordapp.com/invite/hhUVfq[/url]

We've worked really hard on Veritas and now it's finally time to release it to the world and we really want people to play it and see what people think!

See you all soon!

Simon & Graham - Glitch Games
